summary: CarPlay puts app templates on a vehicle's built-in screen through Apple's CarPlay host, with instrument cluster and dashboard scenes. The vehicle head unit and the CarPlay host are outside the tablet port, so the templates have no target. The media session in the shell (now_playing.rs) is a separate counterpart that a CarPlay app would also use. iPadOS 12.0 and later per the index.

features.note: Needs a vehicle head unit and CarPlay host.
Templates are drawn on the vehicle's screen.

Navigation overlays for a head unit.

Templates for the vehicle screen only.
